name: Kling Klang
ownershipStory: Kling Klang began as Kraftwerk's private studio in 1970 and became their own vanity label for master recordings from 1975, letting the band control the pace and ownership of their catalogue rather than working to an external label's schedule.
hook: Kraftwerk's own studio, turned into their own label, so nobody else would own the masters.

blurb.age7: Kling Klang was Kraftwerk's own studio and record label, so they could make music their own way.
blurb.age13: Kling Klang started as the studio Kraftwerk built for themselves in Düsseldorf in 1970, and became their own label in 1975 so they would own their own recordings.
blurb.adult: Kling Klang's dual role as studio and label is a big part of why Kraftwerk's catalogue is so small and so tightly controlled compared to peers: they were never on anyone else's release schedule, and never had to hand over their masters to get a record out.
